name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta province of Argentina. The project hosts a Measured & Indicated resource of 248 Moz silver and 2.54 Moz gold (454 Moz AgEq), with a completed Preliminary Feasibility Study showing a US$494M after-tax NPV and 26% IRR. The company graduated from the TSXV to the TSX in February 2025 and is backed by major shareholders including Eric Sprott and Kinross Gold.
